articles.excerpt: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh — A major tragedy was averted after a suspected sabotage attempt targeted the Bareilly-Tanakpur passenger train. Miscreants filled the railway track with stones and damaged the earthing line at two separate locations.

body.html:
Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh — A major tragedy was averted after a suspected sabotage attempt targeted the Bareilly-Tanakpur passenger train. Miscreants filled the railway track with stones and damaged the earthing line at two separate locations.

The alert loco pilot noticed the obstruction and immediately applied emergency brakes, bringing the train to a halt and preventing a potential disaster.

Railway authorities have launched an investigation, suspecting a deliberate conspiracy to derail the train. Security has been tightened in the area.

Noida — A disturbing video from Noida has surfaced showing a police barrier being tied with a rope and dragged on the road by a Scorpio SUV, with weapons visibly kept inside the vehicle. Authorities confirmed that this was not just vandalism but a direct act of disrespect and provocation toward law enforcement.

The accused — Nishant Pandit, Saurabh Pandit, and Aryaket — have been arrested. The SUV involved in the incident has been seized by police.

Officials are treating the matter seriously, calling it an intentional attempt to incite unrest and insult the police force.

articles.title: Outrage in Pune: Man Caught Urinating on Shivsrushti Poster, Detained After Video Goes Viral 🚨
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune, Maharashtra — A 59-year-old man, Amol Arun Kulkarni, was detained by Pune Police after he was caught on video urinating on a signboard of Shivsrushti — a historical theme park dedicated to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj — at Ambegaon Budruk.

body.html:
Pune, Maharashtra — A 59-year-old man, Amol Arun Kulkarni, was detained by Pune Police after he was caught on video urinating on a signboard of Shivsrushti — a historical theme park dedicated to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj — at Ambegaon Budruk. The shocking act, recorded by students of Sinhgad College around 3 AM on Saturday, has triggered widespread outrage.

The video shows Kulkarni desecrating the memorial’s entrance signage while a woman, believed to be his wife Sneha Amol Kulkarni (57), stood nearby filming on her phone. The footage was shared with members of the Maratha Seva Sangh, who immediately alerted Bharti Vidyapeeth Police.

Senior Inspector Savalaram Salgaonkar confirmed that Kulkarni was taken into custody for questioning. “We are investigating his motive, especially since this happened at such an odd hour,” he said.

According to the complainant, Nayanath Tukaram Amrale (23), two vehicles were parked near the entrance when the act occurred. When confronted, Kulkarni allegedly said arrogantly, “Do whatever you want,” further provoking locals who demanded strict legal action.

An FIR has been registered against both Amol and Sneha Kulkarni under sections related to hurting religious sentiments. Assistant Police Inspector Mithun Pardeshi is leading the investigation.

The act has drawn fierce condemnation from across Maharashtra, with many viewing it as a grave insult to the legacy of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and the pride of the Maratha community.

articles.title: Pune Horror Repeats: Drunk Driver Rams Tea Stall, 12 Injured Including MPSC Aspirants 🚨
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune, Maharashtra — In a chilling repeat of last year’s infamous Porsche crash, a drunk driver caused chaos on Saturday evening after ramming his car into a crowded tea stall near Vishrambag, injuring 12 people — including students preparing for the Maharashtra Public Service Commission...

body.html:
Pune, Maharashtra — In a chilling repeat of last year’s infamous Porsche crash, a drunk driver caused chaos on Saturday evening after ramming his car into a crowded tea stall near Vishrambag, injuring 12 people — including students preparing for the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) exams.

According to Senior Inspector Vijayamaal Pawar of Vishrambag Police Station, the car plowed through multiple vehicles and pedestrians before crashing into the tea stall. At least five people, including a girl student, are reported to be in serious condition. All injured were immediately rushed to nearby hospitals.

Preliminary investigation confirmed that the driver was under the influence of alcohol. A co-passenger was also present in the car, and both have been taken into custody. An FIR has been registered by Vishrambag police.

CCTV footage of the crash has gone viral on social media, sparking outrage. One user wrote, “Pass a general order cancelling the driving license of all criminals including myself. First conduct mental and driving tests, then issue fresh licenses.”

This is the second major accident in Pune involving a drunk driver in just over a year, reigniting calls for stricter enforcement and accountability.

articles.title: 🚨 Jaunpur Murder Mystery: Retired Officer’s Body Found in Bushes, Woman Among 3 Held 🚨
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh — The body of retired District Youth Welfare Officer Ramkripal Yadav was found in the bushes near a posh locality in Jaunpur on Sunday, sending shockwaves across the district.

body.html:
Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh — The body of retired District Youth Welfare Officer Ramkripal Yadav was found in the bushes near a posh locality in Jaunpur on Sunday, sending shockwaves across the district. Yadav, a resident of Bairwa village, had gone out Saturday night with his grandson, who later dropped him near the Baati-Chokha restaurant at Wajidpur intersection, under Line Bazar police station limits.

When Yadav’s phones went unreachable and he did not return, his family alerted the police. CCTV footage showed a woman and a man taking Yadav on a scooter at 2:11 AM. His body was discovered hours later in nearby bushes.

Based on the footage, police arrested three individuals, including a woman. During a search of the accused’s homes, investigators found suspicious items, including sex-enhancement pills. One suspect allegedly washed the scooter and cleaned her house to eliminate evidence before the police arrived.

While officials suspect a possible extramarital link behind the murder, no formal motive has been confirmed. A senior officer stated that a thorough investigation is ongoing and the accused are being interrogated.

body.html:
Basti, Uttar Pradesh — Panic spread near the district hospital in Basti after a motorcycle caught fire while being started. The flames quickly spread to a nearby scooter, engulfing both vehicles.

Locals rushed to douse the flames by throwing water, but their efforts failed. Within minutes, both the bike and scooter were reduced to ashes.

No injuries have been reported, but the incident has raised questions about fire safety near public facilities. Authorities are yet to confirm the exact cause of the fire.
